args.query: renter cost burdened gross rent percent of household income by income bracket

sql: SELECT "year", SUM(renters_cost_burdened)*100.0/SUM(renter_households) AS pct, SUM(renters_severely_burdened)*100.0/SUM(renter_households) AS sev, SUM(owners_cost_burdened) AS own FROM census.acs_congressional_district WHERE "year" IN (2019,2024) GROUP BY "year" ORDER BY "year"
